description.value: Mighty Riders is a full-service bicycle shop on West Broadway in Vancouver carrying premium road and gravel brands including Argon18, Bianchi, Brodie, and Knolly. The shop is known for a rider-centric professional fitting program that uses an adjustable size-cycle and sizing software spanning 40-plus brands to find the ideal geometry for each cyclist. Touring cyclists will find a versatile repair workshop covering all bike styles plus a unique EVOC travel bag rental service for those flying with their bikes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Mighty Riders as an active full-service bicycle shop on West Broadway, Vancouver. The services page explicitly lists bike repairs on 'any conceivable style of bicycle' including road, gravel, mountain, and commuter, supporting the urgent mechanicals criterion; no pump is mentioned anywhere on the site. A notable concern is that the bike fitting contact and travel bag rental page both reference a distinct business — 'On The Rivet Cycle Wear' — with a different phone number (604-677-0700) and email (Info@ontherivet.ca), suggesting shared premises or a close operational partnership that may need clarification.
concerns: Website's bike fitting booking and travel bag rental pages direct customers to a separate business, 'On The Rivet Cycle Wear', with a different phone (604-677-0700) and email (Info@ontherivet.ca / Ontherivetcyclewear@gmail.com). The relationship between Mighty Riders and On The Rivet is unclear — they may share premises or have merged operations. The primary contact info (info@mightyriders.ca, 604-879-8705) still appears consistently in the site footer, so OSM data appears current, but the dual-brand situation warrants a closer look.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service bike shop with confirmed repairs across all bike styles, professional fitting, and travel bag rental — a solid resource for touring cyclists passing through or departing from Vancouver.
